description: The unsigned chooseFactor(factorId, version) transaction: the account copies the factor's current terms (version shown in the answer); a change the factor publishes later applies only after the owner chooses it again. Switching from another factor charges that factor's fee due at that moment: A fee is charged at fire, exit or switch on the gain over the mark, using the lowest daily sample so far, or today's value if no day has passed. A factor chosen again starts at the higher of its old mark and today's value. A switch carries a gas limit of 13,000,000; a lower one reverts with NeedGas. Refused for a factor that is not listed or has stopped. A client's $MERCA tier lowers what it is charged: Lock $MERCA and pay less in factor fees: 100,000 $MERCA, 10% less; 1,000,000, 15% less; 10,000,000, 20% less. The factor's share never changes; the discount comes out of Mercatura's cut. Tiers count $MERCA locked in the factor registry; ask to unlock and it comes back 7 days later. These are the launch numbers; Mercatura can change them. Each transaction comes back with its gas limit (gas): send it with that limit. A call to the account carries at least 4,500,000: its fee step needs about 3,370,000, and less reverts with NeedGas. Needs the owner's signed request (auth) for request "choose-factor".

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

factorId.description: The factor's ERC-8004 agentId, from list_factors.
